rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3. Its operating conditions and sudden stopping without an obstacle are supported by H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the evaluation subject, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not expand into sensing, computation, communication, failure mitigation, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “The vehicle's braking behavior” directly concerns the behaviour targeted by “Prevent unintended braking.”
The declared road, speed, weather, direction of travel, and absence of visible obstacles or vehicles match H-3's operational situation.
“Whether the vehicle continues normally or suddenly stops without an obstacle present” characterises the occurrence or absence of the hazardous braking behaviour.
“Suddenly stops” is a temporal feature of the hazardous event explicitly described in H-3, rather than an imported mechanism timing constraint.
